podcast.body: This album marked Fleetwood Mac's return to a more "Centrist Pop" sound, shifting away from the experimental nature of "Tusk." Its lead single, "Hold Me," featured a joint vocal between Christine McVie and Lindsey Buckingham, reminiscent of "Don't Stop." While "Hold Me" was in the Hot 100's top five, "Mirage" hit number one on the album chart in mid-August 1982. "In mid-August, while the song was locked in the top five, Marage hit number 1 on the album chart."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
